screenshots.name: wh-receiving-list
screenshots.description: Restructured receiving page with tab switcher (Receiving History + Analytics), collapsible search filters, and new table columns (Date, Invoice Number, Contract Number, Company, Department, Quantity, Total)
screenshots.desiredState: Receiving page fully loaded with Receiving History tab active. Page header shows Import from RS and + Create Receipt buttons. Tab bar shows Receiving History (with count badge) and Analytics tabs. Collapsible search filter panel visible. Table shows rows with columns: Date, Invoice Number, Contract Number, Company, Department, Quantity, Total.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the restructured receiving page with new tab layout, filters panel, and updated table columns — not the old list/grouped view

screenshots.name: wh-receiving-review
screenshots.description: Review Items modal showing document info cards (Document #, Date, Company, Amount), matched items with lot/expiry tracking, and department selector
screenshots.desiredState: Review Items modal is open showing document info cards at top, department selector with Receive without contract checkbox, matched items table with Quantity, Price, Total columns and Unmatch buttons, and per-item Lot Number and Expiry Date fields.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Review Items modal — not the receiving list page, not the Create Receipt wizard

stateSetup.description: Navigate to receiving page, click on a receipt row to open the Review Items modal

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-row-key], tbody tr'); for (var r of rows) { if (r.querySelector('td')) { r.click(); return 'clicked first data row'; } } return 'no data rows found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The row click selector may need adjustment. The Review Items modal may only appear for RS-imported receipts.

mustShow: Lot Number and Expiry Date fields
mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal

screenshots.name: wh-transfers-list
screenshots.description: Transfers page showing grouped view with transfer records, status badges, and tab bar including Pending Approval tab with orange count badge
screenshots.desiredState: Transfers page fully loaded. Tab bar shows All Transfers, Grouped View, and Pending Approval tabs. The Pending Approval tab has an orange badge with the count of pending items. Table displays transfer records with columns: document number, date, source/destination departments, status.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the transfers list page with the tab bar visible (especially the Pending Approval tab with badge) — not the transfer creation modal

mustShow: Transfer table rows or empty state

screenshots.name: wh-transfer-create
screenshots.description: Transfer creation modal (Transfer Book) with source/destination department selectors and dual-panel item picker for selecting inventory items
screenshots.desiredState: Transfer Book modal is open showing the dual-panel interface. Header has date, document number, From Department dropdown, To Department dropdown, and Direct Write-Off toggle. Left panel shows available items from source department. Right panel shows selected items for transfer.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Transfer Book modal with dual panels — not the transfers list page, not the approval tab

stateSetup.description: Navigate to transfers page and click the New Transfer button to open the Transfer Book modal

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var b of btns) { var rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.top < 120 && b.textContent.trim().length > 0 && rect.width > 80) { b.click(); return 'clicked header action button'; } } return 'no button found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The New Transfer button selector may need adjustment based on actual DOM structure. Look for a prominent action button in the page header.

mustShow: Dual panel layout or item picker area
mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal

screenshots.name: wh-transfer-approval
screenshots.description: Pending Approval tab on the Transfers page showing transfers awaiting confirmation with confirm and delete action buttons
screenshots.desiredState: Transfers page with the Pending Approval tab active. The tab shows a list of transfers that need confirmation from the receiving department. Each row has transfer details (document number, items, source/destination) and action buttons (confirm, delete).
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Pending Approval tab content — not the All Transfers or Grouped View tabs, not the Transfer Book modal

stateSetup.description: Navigate to transfers page and click the Pending Approval tab

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'); for (var t of tabs) { var badge = t.querySelector('[class*="badge"], [class*="Badge"], span[style]'); if (badge || tabs.length >= 3) { if (t === tabs[tabs.length - 1]) { t.click(); return 'clicked last tab (pending approval)'; } } } if (tabs.length >= 3) { tabs[2].click(); return 'clicked third tab'; } return 'tabs not found, count: ' + tabs.length; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The Pending Approval tab may be the 3rd tab. If no pending transfers exist, an empty state will be shown. The orange badge count depends on live data.

mustShow: Transfer rows with action buttons or empty state

screenshots.name: wh-orders-list
screenshots.description: Orders page showing all orders list with status badges (draft, active, completed, cancelled) and confirmation queue tab
screenshots.desiredState: Orders page fully loaded with All Orders tab active. Table shows order rows with columns: document number, date, requester department, receiver department, status badge. Tab bar shows All Orders, Grouped View, and Confirmation Queue tabs (confirmation queue tab may have orange badge).
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the orders list page with status badges — not the Order Book modal, not the confirmation queue tab

mustShow: Order table rows or empty state

screenshots.name: wh-order-create
screenshots.description: Order Book modal with requester and receiver department selectors and dual-panel item picker for selecting products to order
screenshots.desiredState: Order Book modal is open showing the dual-panel interface. Header has date, document number, Requester Department dropdown, and Receiver Department dropdown. Left panel shows available items from the receiver's inventory. Right panel shows selected items for the order.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Order Book modal with dual panels — not the orders list page, not the confirmation queue

stateSetup.description: Navigate to orders page and click the Order Book button to open the order creation modal

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var b of btns) { var rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.top < 120 && b.textContent.trim().length > 0 && rect.width > 80) { b.click(); return 'clicked header action button'; } } return 'no button found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The orders page may have two buttons (Order Book and Create Waybill). The first/leftmost prominent button is typically Order Book. If the wrong modal opens, the button selection logic may need adjustment.

mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal

screenshots.name: wh-inventory-balances
screenshots.description: Stock balances table showing inventory levels with department filter, search fields, quantity columns, and expiry status badges
screenshots.desiredState: Inventory page loaded with the Stock Levels tab active. Table shows stock items with columns: code, goods name, type, quantity, price, total, unit, expiration (with color-coded badges), and series/lot. Filter panel visible with department dropdown and filter options.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the stock balances table with filter panel — not the picking queue tab, not any modal

mustShow: Stock balance table rows or empty state

screenshots.name: wh-inventory-picking
screenshots.description: FEFO picking queue tab showing approved transfer request cards and pick list table with lot-level suggestions sorted by expiration date
screenshots.desiredState: Inventory page with the Picking Queue tab active. Left side shows transfer request cards (each with item name, source/destination departments, quantity needed). Right side or below shows the pick list table with lot-level rows sorted by expiration (FEFO), including columns: product code/name, bin location, lot number, expiration date, quantity requested, suggested pick, confirmed pick.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the FEFO picking queue tab — not the stock balances tab, not any modal

stateSetup.description: Navigate to inventory page and click the Picking Queue tab

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'); for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) { if (i >= 1) { tabs[i].click(); return 'clicked tab index ' + i; } } return 'tabs not found, count: ' + tabs.length; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The Picking Queue tab position may vary. If no approved transfers exist, the queue will show an empty state. FEFO lot suggestions depend on actual inventory data.

mustShow: Transfer request cards or pick list or empty state
mustNotShow: Stock balances table from the first tab

screenshots.name: wh-receipt-create
screenshots.description: Create Receipt 3-step wizard showing Step 1: Shipment Details with supplier, department, invoice number, and delivery date fields
screenshots.desiredState: Create Receipt wizard is open showing Step 1 (Shipment Details). Form shows fields for supplier, department, invoice number, and delivery date. Step indicators visible at top showing 3 steps.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Create Receipt wizard Step 1 — not the Review Items modal, not the receiving list page

stateSetup.description: Navigate to receiving page and click + Create Receipt button to open the wizard

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var b of btns) { var t = b.textContent.trim(); if (t.indexOf('Create') !== -1 || t.indexOf('+') !== -1) { var rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.top < 120) { b.click(); return 'clicked create receipt button'; } } } return 'no button found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The Create Receipt button may be the second button in the header (after Import from RS).

mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal

screenshots.name: wh-receiving-analytics
screenshots.description: Analytics tab on the receiving page showing summary statistics and charts for receiving operations
screenshots.desiredState: Receiving page with the Analytics tab active. Shows summary statistics and visual charts for receiving operations trends.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Analytics tab content — not the Receiving History tab, not any modal

stateSetup.description: Navigate to receiving page and click the Analytics tab

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'); for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) { var t = tabs[i].textContent.toLowerCase(); if (t.indexOf('analytics') !== -1 || t.indexOf('analytic') !== -1) { tabs[i].click(); return 'clicked analytics tab'; } } if (tabs.length >= 2) { tabs[1].click(); return 'clicked second tab'; } return 'tabs not found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The Analytics tab may be the second tab. Content depends on available data.

mustShow: Statistics or charts or empty state
